articles.summary: GRPO on 500 SWE agent training tasks created by AfterQuery raised Qwen3.8-27B’s DeepSWE pass@1 (avg 3) from 27.8% to 39.1%.
articles.title: Improving Qwen3.8-27B-Medium on DeepSWE with GRPO

articles.summary: AfterQuery and Hebbia post-trained the NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL open model on expert-written public credit tasks. Perfect solves on a 100-task held-out set rose from 47% to 74%.
articles.title: Post-Training NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL for Finance: More Accurate, Cost-Efficient Financial Credit Analysis
